set tsc= $$$ERROR("Grp Link Not found") set errorMsg = " Group Link Not found " _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId $$$TRACE( "-- Find GS Grp Link --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version) WRITE !, "-- Find GS Interchge Link --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version _ ", Mode: " _ mode _ ", Direction: " _ direction

&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR select r.ID, r.name from IHC_ERP_TPManage.TradeLink r, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TpId t1, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TpId t2, IHC_ERP_TPManage.TransactionType tr where r.IsaSenderId = t1.ID and r.IsaReceiverId = t2.ID and R.TransactionType = tr.ID and t1.TPID = :senderId and t2.TPID = :receiverId and tr.VERSION = :version and r.Direction = :direction ) &sql(OPEN WPCursor) if (SQLCODE'=0) RETURN tsc FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :id, :relNm) WRITE !, "ItfFind InterchageLink :SQLCODE: " _ SQLCODE if (SQLCODE = 0) { WRITE !, id _", :" _ relNm set errorMsg = " FOUND TRADELINK for ISA: " _ relNm _", " _ senderId _", " _ receiverId _", " _ docType _", " _ version
